artworks.name: milestones
artworks.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE tall continuous illustration for a narrow bookshelf navigation panel. EXTREMELY TALL PORTRAIT canvas, approximately 1:5 aspect ratio (512 wide by 2560 tall). This is a full-height bookmark composition, NOT an icon at the top of a blank panel. The subject must connect the top 5% to the bottom 95% through long flowing forms, with interesting drawn details in the upper, middle and lower thirds. Keep main contours in the central 75% of width; generous thin side margin but virtually no empty vertical space. Style: a charming 1950s educational picture-book print, simplified hand-drawn contours, muted vermilion and butter-cream and golden-yellow and dark charcoal-green inks, gently uneven edges, fine worn screenprint grain, flat hand-painted shapes, slightly whimsical exaggerated proportions. NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, NOT a modern app icon. Actual TRANSPARENT background everywhere outside the drawing, including internal holes; no opaque background rectangle, no drawn checkerboard, no borders, no labels, no typography, no numbers, no watermark. The object itself must be designed as an extremely long slender illustration; do not put a small normal-sized object in a large empty canvas. A whimsical impossibly tall pendulum clock mechanism. At the very top a small round butter-yellow clock face with dark green hands and simple tick marks (no numerals), tiny vermilion bells. Two fine ivory suspension cords run all the way down, one gently looping near the middle, carrying two small golden clock weights at different heights. A very long slender ivory pendulum stem descends from the clock to a large warm yellow circular pendulum bob near the bottom. A few small vermilion mechanical accents are spaced down the rods. One visually continuous graceful clock construction. Clear silhouette on a muted indigo webpage background.
